About the show

Recommended age 7+ CELEBRATING 40 YEARS OF THE TRON PANTOShe’s no’ just frozen… she’s baltic! Christmas is running like a dream down in Santa’s (aka Kristine Cagney Kringle’s) workshop. All nice and naughty lists have been checked off. Nothing can go wrong. Until a broken magic mirror unleashes...

Concessions at Tron Theatre

The Tron has scrapped concession types altogether. Every show is sold at three price points and you choose which to pay — so the lowest price on a listing here is the lowest price anyone pays, with no eligibility to prove.

Choose what you pay

Open to everyone. Pick from the three price points shown when booking.

Groups

Groups may be eligible for a discount — contact the Box Office on 0141 552 4267.

Fees

No booking fees.
